title: Software Engineer I
description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?
At Trader Interactive , we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.
When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.
What We Offer

• An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

• The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

• Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You'll Do
As a Software Engineer I at Trader Interactive , you will contribute to the implementation of foundational product features, writing high-quality, secure, and maintainable code under technical guidance. You will be responsible for adhering to established development standards, managing individual task delivery, and writing robust unit tests to ensure application health. Collaborating closely within your engineering team, you will focus on building your domain expertise, absorbing code review feedback, and proactively aligning technical execution with the team's immediate delivery goals. In this role, the Software Engineer I actively develops their technical skill set and fosters collaborative peer connections, contributing to the steady execution and success of the task force.

• Consistently write and maintain secure, maintainable, readable, and testable code under supervision, ensuring all deliverables strictly meet relevant acceptance criteria and the team's Definition of Done.

• Implement basic features and core functions within a software component while building an introductory understanding of the broader component architecture and standard design patterns.

• Adhere closely to established team development standards, style guides, and coding best practices, incorporating code review feedback loops, including critically reviewing AI-generated code before submission, to optimize technical execution.

• Identify, report, and debug technical issues within familiar codebases and local systems, collaborating actively with peers and utilizing standard team troubleshooting workflows to resolve blockers quickly.

• Actively participate in unit testing efforts and automated testing setups with engineering guidance, aligning code output with the organization's testing pyramid objectives.

• Use AI-assisted development tools (such as AI code assistants) to accelerate routine coding, testing, and debugging tasks, always validating generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability before use.

• Engage in foundational innovation and domain growth by sharing useful execution ideas, researching team systems, and pursuing stretch assignments to expand overall domain knowledge.

• Observe and collaborate with senior team members to learn task breakdown methodologies, aiming to provide reliable, data-backed effort estimations for individual deliverables.

• Proactively identify, escalate, and communicate dependencies, technical friction, or blockers within persona

title: Civil Project Engineer - Industrial Environmental
description:
Company Description

We are Olsson . We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results - for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson . It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description
Join Olsson 's Industrial Environmental team as a Project Engineer and be part of creating innovative solutions that drive positive change in communities. In this role, you will apply diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices to a broad variety of assignments and related fields. The project engineer is a registered professional engineer, whose supervision and guidance relate largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts, and policy matters. The project engineer supervises, coordinates, and reviews work of engineers or technicians and performs complex or novel assignments that require development of new and improved techniques and procedures.
Key Responsibilities:

• Prepares planning and design documents in appropriate engineering discipline.

• Coordinates assistant and associate professional staff and technical staff’s work; may supervise lower-level staff.

• Performs process design calculations, prepares cost estimates, and uses economic analyses for comparison of alternatives.

• Develops project scope of work; develops project schedule; prepares project initiation paperwork; manages budget reviews and schedules progress reports.

• Coordinates projects with other Olsson teams; performs and coordinates design aspects of projects; directs team members on design tasks; maintains project records (correspondence, drawings, and files); coordinates with clients; attends client meetings.

• Manages the preparation of technical reports, memos, and summaries to effectively communicate findings to clients and internal teams.

• Serves as project manager for projects.

• Collaborate with project managers and multidisciplinary teams to ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within budget, and meet client expectations.

• Assist with marketing / business development and prepare project proposals

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to contribute and work well with a team.

• Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in civil or environmental engineering from an ABET-accredited institution.

• 8 or more years of relevant civil or environmental engineering experience, specifically with civil or environmental design including solid waste facilities, environmental remediation, and mining reclamation.

• Must be a registered Professional Engineer.

• Proficiency with engineering tools, software, and methodologies.

• Strong working knowledge of Civil 3D and AutoCAD.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

• Receive a competitive 401(k) match

• Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths

• Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements

• Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities

• Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior Data Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $155,000-$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an accomplished Senior Data Engineer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade data platforms, scalable data pipelines, and distributed data processing systems that support analytics, business intelligence, and machine learning initiatives across multiple business domains. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end data engineering lifecycle, from translating business and analytical requirements into robust data architectures, to developing reliable ETL/ELT pipelines, to deploying cloud-native data solutions and supporting them throughout their operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in data engineering, distributed computing, cloud data platforms, and database technologies, combined with strong hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions. You will work closely with data scientists, business analysts, software engineers, solution architects, DevOps engineers, and stakeholders in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality, reliable, and governed data platforms that directly support strategic business outcomes.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related technical discipline.

• Hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms and analytics solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed storage, compute, networking, security, identity management, and data integration services.

title: Sr. Network Engineer II
description:
Job Description:
The Sr. Network Engineer II is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex, mission-critical network infrastructures that bridge traditional data centers and modern multi-cloud environments. Demanding elite technical depth in architecture, security, and automation, this role ensures the highest levels of reliability and performance-with an active CCIE (or equivalent expert-level credential) strongly preferred as a testament to advanced design and troubleshooting mastery.

• Design, deploy, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance network architectures across on-premise and cloud environments.

• Lead network infrastructure projects, including data center, WAN, LAN, and cloud connectivity initiatives.

• Implement and manage advanced routing and switching protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN).

• Oversee network security implementations, including firewalls, VPNs, network segmentation, and zero-trust principles.

• Develop and manage automation workflows for network provisioning, configuration, and monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and modern scripting methodologies.

• Optimize network performance, capacity planning, and reliability.

• Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for critical network incidents in high-availability environments.

• Partner with cross-functional teams (Security, Systems, Cloud, DevOps) to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.

• Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to the network architecture.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers.

• Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

• Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

• 8+ years of hands-on network engineering experience in large-scale enterprise or service provider environments.

• 3 +years of operational experience in a Cloud, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role.

• Strong, hands-on experience operating within major public enterprise cloud platforms.

• Strong experience with network security (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs).

• Experience and proficiency in network automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using modern scripting languages and configuration management tools.

Reapraは、私たちが今後伸びゆく、次世代を跨ぐ社会課題があると考えているターゲット領域に対して、起業家が強く動機づき長期的にコミットしていくこと、自分と向き合い続けることを可能にするための方法論を、メンバー・起業家と共に試行錯誤しながら生み出し、研究と実践とサイクルを回し続けます。最終的にはReapra独自の方法論を、再現性があるものにまで一般化していくことを目指します。 Reapraでは、共に実践する仲間にIntensive Fondation Designという、自己を知りどのように自らの生きづらさを社会に適用していくか、その実践に向けてどのような自分の癖に向き合い、学び方を変えていく必要があるか、といった点を整理する探究セッションを起業家・社員・インターンに提供しています。 私たちは起業家が自ら向き合いながら、事業を作ることへのサポートを行うことで、起業家の学習変容を促し、またその道のりで私たちRearpaメンバーも共に変容し共同学習を続けていきます。
🌟 スタートアップの未来を創る仲間を募集中！
私たちは、次世代の起業家と共に成長するコミュニティを創造しています。大学生から社会人まで、起業家精神を持つ仲間を募集中です！

• 仲間探しや起業家との出会いをコーディネート：刺激的な出会いと学びがたくさん！

• 起業を考える大学生向けイベントの企画・運営：学びと楽しさを両立したイベントを企画・運営 - その他にも興味があることを業務に出来るチャンス有り！

✨ こんな方を待っています
-スタートアップの成長に本気で関わりたい方
-理論と実践の両方で学びたい方 - 起業家との深い関係性を築きたい方
- 新しいことに挑戦したい方 - 将来的な起業を視野に入れている方
- 起業をしたいが、立ち止まっている方
- 自分の内面について深く知りたい、探究したい方
Requirements
📍 活動環境
-完全フルリモート -週15時間～
-半年以上稼働できる方 -経験・スキルは不問。成長意欲を重視します
※大学の講義や試験などに合わせた、フレキシブルな勤務が可能です！ 🎯求める人物像 - 世代を跨ぐ社会課題に対して、産業創造するミッションに関心がある方

下記のような動機の方はマッチングしない可能性が高いことご了承ください
- 就活や起業のためにスキルや専門性を身につけたい
- 形式的なインターン経験だけを求めている

title: Project Controller
description:
As a member of the Project Services team and working closely with the Project Management Office, the Project Controller is involved from project award to completion, is a master in the art of ERP systems and cost control in a professional services environment.
Responsibilities

• Manage the day-to-day cost controls requirements for the assigned projects utilizing standard systems, against which trends, scope changes, commitments, payments, forecasts, and budget variances are monitored and reported

• Develop custom reporting tools for unique client requirements

• Develop and establish robust standards to implement across the company’s portfolio of projects

• Work closely with the accounting department to ensure complete and accurate reporting of project costs

• Work closely with Project Managers to create and maintain project budgets and schedules including defined goals and objectives

• Acts as the ERP system subject matter expert (Ajera - Deltek)

• Support and train other stakeholders including Project Managers on the tips, tricks, and best practices of the ERP

• Ensure that logical structures are in place for each project to collect and report on project costs, schedule performance, project scope, and execution strategies

• Degree in Engineering, Business, Construction Management, Accounting or Finance

• Project Controls experience - minimum 5 years

• Membership in AACEI is an advantage

• Technical expert in excel and SQL - xLookups, Pivot Tables, and database queries

• Previous experience with ERP systems

• Strong attention to detail, problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Previous experience in a consulting engineering environment is considered an asset

• Familiarity with the different contracting strategies encountered on EPC and EPCM projects in North America

• Advanced knowledge of Earned Value Management and Risk Analyses Techniques

• Sound communication skills, fluency in English a must, French is considered an asset

Sacré-Davey offers a competitive compensation package, as well as a creative, cohesive work environment and continuous opportunity for development. If you would like to be considered for this opportunity please submit your resume and cover letter, including a description of projects and accomplishments relevant to the position.
Sacré-Davey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider employment applicants without regard to age, race, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other protected status. If you have any accessibility or special requirements, please let us know and we will do our utmost to accommodate, in accordance with applicable local legislation.
Sacré-Davey is a privately held, multi-disciplinary engineering and project management firm that services the mining, energy, and general industrial sectors. With offices in Canada, the United States, and the Philippines, we offer our clients professional services and global technical expertise to de-risk and maximize the value of their projects.
The diverse range of projects that we deliver include mineral processing plants, green and blue hydrogen production facilities, wastewater treatment plants, technology scale-up, renewable fuels, GHG reduction, power generation facilities, bulk material terminals and food processing plants.
We strive to deliver projects with excellence and help our clients grow and succeed with a focus on sustainability and responsible development. We are on a mission to create a more sustainable future for us all and need talented professionals to help us reach our goals.

title: RN Care Manager
description:
RN Care Manager PART TIME - Babyscripts About Babyscripts
Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital health, dedicated to transforming maternal care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and patient engagement. Our digital tools help healthcare providers monitor, educate, and support their patients in real-time, enhancing overall care coordination and improving maternal and fetal health outcomes.
About the Role
We are seeking a part-time RN Care Manager to support maternal health patients through care coordination, remote patient monitoring, and clinical assessment. This role is ideal for licensed Registered Nurses (RNs) with experience in case management, maternal health, or telehealth who are looking for a flexible position in a digital care environment.
As a part-time team member, you will monitor patient data, conduct clinical assessments, educate patients, and escalate high-risk cases to providers using established protocols. You’ll play an important role in improving maternal health outcomes-while working remotely with a flexible schedule aligned to business needs.
This is a remote, part-time (approximately 24 hours/week) position, with some flexibility around days and hours.
Key Responsibilities

• Monitor patient data trends (e.g., blood pressure, weight, symptoms) and identify high-risk cases requiring intervention.

• Perform clinical assessments via phone, telehealth, or messaging to provide education, intervention, and care plan adjustments.

• Provide direct patient education on managing hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia risks, postpartum recovery, and other maternal health concerns.

• Escalate high-risk cases to the appropriate provider per established protocols.

• Support care coordination by assisting patients with referrals, scheduling follow-ups, and connecting them to additional resources.

• Ensure compliance with RPM protocols by coaching patients on adherence and addressing barriers to engagement.

• Document all clinical interactions in Babyscripts ' care management platform, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

• Active, unrestricted RN license in the U.S. (multi-state compact license preferred).

• Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience in maternal health, OB/GYN, case management, remote patient monitoring, or other relevant fields.

• Experience in telehealth, digital health, or RPM platforms is highly preferred.

• Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills to manage maternal health risks effectively.

• Excellent patient communication skills with the ability to educate, engage, and empower patients in their care.

• Proficiency with EHRs, care management platforms, and digital health tools.

• Bilingual (Spanish preferred).

Compensation & Benefits

• Salary: Based on experience and licensure; part-time compensation is pro-rated based on a 24-hour workweek.

• Quarterly Bonuses: Eligible based on patient engagement, quality benchmarks, and documentation accuracy (pro-rated based on hours worked).

• Flexible Scheduling: Self-managed hours in coordination with team needs and coverage goals.

• Remote Work:
• Work-from-home stipend available.

Note: Part-time employees are not eligible for full-time medical, dental, vision, or 401(k) benefits, but may be eligible for select company perks depending on hours worked and tenure.
Staffing & Coverage Expectations

• Maintain a consistent 24-hour/week schedule, with flexibility around days and hours based on team coverage needs.

• Coordinate any changes in availability or time off in advance to ensure patient continuity.

• In the case of urgent PTO, coordinate handoffs with the team to ensure no disruption in patient care.

title: Interested in joining the KARE Revolution?
description:
Do You KARE ?

Who We Are

KARE is the first labor marketplace dedicated solely to the Senior Housing and Post-Acute industry. KARE connects qualified caregivers and nurses (we call them Heroes) with Senior Care Communities and Nursing Homes. The KARE app gives caregivers the flexibility to create a schedule that works for them, and it gives communities the ability to quickly fill open shifts, delivering a revolutionary approach to solving staffing challenges.

Who We Want

• Are you passionate about making an impact in the senior living industry?

• When you see a problem, do you immediately start working towards a solution?

• Do you love working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment building the future of an organization?

• Are you able to see through chaos to create a clear plan of action?

• Do you thrive working with multiple key stakeholders and ensuring everyone is on the same page?

• Are you a self-starter who can work from home independently and get stuff done?

• Are you highly organized, detail oriented while juggling multiple projects at one time?

What You Will Do

We are a fast-growing organization! We have roles available at certain times in the functions of:

• Market Growth- Working directly with our community customers to ensure successful use of KARE in their communities. Roles include General Manager, Guru/Regional Account Executive

• Company Growth- Similar to market growth but with a more relationship-based approach to National Account Management. Roles include Implementation, Guru/National Account Executive

• HERO Development- Passionate about the frontline worker, this team works directly with our Heroes and HERO candidates to ensure that KARE is their #1 choice for flexible work.

• Marketing- Bringing the voice of KARE to life. This can include social media, digital marketing, tradeshow organization, PR and branding and more.

• Product- Ensuring the KARE product is best in class for our community partners and Heroes.

• Operations/People Operations - This is for the highly organized that like to focus internally to make sure our people and process are working smoothly.

What You Need

• Experience in senior living industry is not a must have, but it helps for certain roles

• Able to work in an ambiguous environment where things continuously change

• Must have an affinity for the color orange!! We love to wear the KARE brand loud and proud.

• Some roles have very little travel and some roles travel a lot! In general, an ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including potential international travel.

• Willing to dig in and do the work! If you want to just advise or delegate, this is not the place for you.

If this sounds like you, we ask you to apply and provide some basic information. We will reach out if we want to talk further about joining the KARE Revolution!

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

 

The role in a nutshell:

We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer  to engineer and secure our multi-cloud environment,  the same cloud infrastructure that powers our product. This is a cloud-native, AI-obsessed company, and our cloud is the platform our product runs on. How we design, harden, and evolve it directly shapes what we can build and how fast we can build it safely. As open source software increasingly feeds AI agents as well as human engineers, securing that supply chain end-to-end is core to our mission. You'll formally report to the Sr Director of Cyber Resiliency and spend time embedded in project pods building alongside our product engineering partners. We're a late-stage startup, which means priorities, tooling, and scope can shift quickly.

• Engineer and maintain cloud environments built to be secure, resilient, and optimized for performance 

• Partner hands-on with internal engineering teams to embed security into the architecture and tooling developers use every day

• Adapt architecture and priorities as the company scales,  reworking plans as needs, tooling, or team structure shift

• Assist during relevant incident response investigations

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills

• Strong, hands-on GCP or AWS engineering experience required

• Experience with Azure also a plus

• Solid DevOps background: comfortable using Terraform/IaC, Kubernetes (GKE), and CI/CD pipelines

• A track record of designing systems that are secure, resilient, and built to accelerate engineering velocity

• Comfort with ambiguity and rapid change: prior experience at a fast-moving or late-stage startup is a strong plus

title: Sustainability data advisor
description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

THE ROLE

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically-minded individual to be a member of our Mexico City office on the Sustainability data advisory team. This is an opportunity to join a core team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world's top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform - enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact and achieve their sustainability goals.

You will:

- Advise sustainability teams at many of the world’s top companies. You’ll work directly with customers on how to measure actionable carbon and non-carbon footprints to reach sustainability goals and enable real reductions, ranging from scoping new measurements to in-depth methodology comparisons between footprints.

- Deliver services that accelerate customer success, helping customers set up their measurements to meet sustainability goals, serving as a trusted partner in emissions verifications, and providing specialized advisory to optimize their data and methodologies. - Have 4-6 years of experience in a consulting, solutions-engineering, or other customer-facing role. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them set the foundation for world-class sustainability programs.

- Have experience in sustainability-related fields, greenhouse gas accounting and/or ESG reporting.

- Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume environment.

- Think clearly about complex problems, and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed.

- Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup.

- Have strong English language proficiency

This position is required to be in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week.

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. title: Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

- Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

- Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

- Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

- Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

- Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

- Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

- Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

- Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

- Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

- Participate in Security Incident response

QUALIFICATIONS

- Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

- Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

- Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

- Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

- Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

title: Platform Engineer, AI Enablement
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s AI Enablement team builds the shared platforms that help people across the company use language models and AI agents safely, reliably, and cost-effectively. As an early member of this platform team, you’ll help shape both the technical foundations and the standards for how AI-powered tools are built and operated across Wayve.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll design, build, and operate infrastructure for model access, agent runtimes, and observability. You’ll take projects from initial problem definition through technical design, deployment, and ongoing operation, partnering closely with security, IT, and engineering teams. You’ll also support teams adopting the platform by troubleshooting issues, documenting reusable patterns, and helping people understand what’s possible with the tools available.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- A governed, production-ready access layer for language models, including routing, authentication, cost controls, and auditability.

- Secure infrastructure and reusable tooling for running agentic workflows in production.

- Observability covering platform usage, cost, reliability, and performance.

- Governance and safety controls that make AI use secure, compliant, and auditable.

- Shared primitives, standards, and best practices that enable teams to build and deploy agents without creating one-off infrastructure.

- Reliable, scalable deployments using cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong software engineering experience building APIs, services, or developer tooling.

- You’ve built or operated platforms and infrastructure used by other engineering teams.

- You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.

- You’re familiar with LLM APIs and the surrounding ecosystem, such as model gateways, agent frameworks, MCP, or RAG.

- You understand production observability, including metrics, tracing, and logging.

- You take a security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, governance, and auditability.

- You’re comfortable taking ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can communicate clearly through documentation and collaboration.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. ADL is the leading anti-hate organization in the world. Founded in 1913, its timeless mission is “to stop the defamation of the Jewish people and to secure justice and fair treatment to all.” Today, ADL continues to fight all forms of antisemitism and bias, using innovation and partnerships to drive impact. A global leader in combating antisemitism, countering extremism and battling bigotry wherever and whenever it happens, ADL works to protect democracy and ensure a just and inclusive society for all.
PRIMARY FUNCTION:
Serve as the Tampa Bay area’s on-the-ground in-community representative and primary point of contact with volunteers, law enforcement, government officials, religious and community leaders. Engage current supporters and cultivate new relationships to increase awareness of ADL’s work and identify programmatic and partnership/coalition-building opportunities.

Primary:

• Participate in government affairs activities, maintaining regular contact with state, local and national officials. Advocate for ADL issues in state and local legislature.

• Manage the region’s leadership group in the area including its local ADL Advisory Council.

• Track relevant issues and provide regular updates to regional (and divisional) staff. Identify opportunities for the region to strategically engage.

• Problem-solving, thoughtful decision-making, and the ability to take initiative, be assertive and prioritize are needed for success.

• Strong understanding of F2P game economics and metrics, including retention, engagement, monetization, LTV, CPI, and related product performance indicators

• Comfort working with analytics and experimentation, including interpreting data, forming hypotheses, designing tests, and acting on results

• Experience using AI-assisted tools for ideation, prototyping, analysis, design, or content creation

title: Software Engineer, Grok Connectors
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer on the Grok Connectors team at SpaceXAI, you'll build the integrations that let Grok, Cursor and Grok Bot do real work inside the tools people use every day: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar and Drive, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, GitHub, Slack, finance accounts, and a fast-growing marketplace of third-party MCP plugins. You'll architect, implement, and deploy features end to end, from OAuth sign-in and token handling, to tool schemas and reliability across hundreds of millions of tool calls, to the cards and approval flows users see on web, desktop, and mobile. You'll work directly with enterprise customers and partners to ship connectors that large organizations can trust.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have an entrepreneurial spirit and love creating outsized business impact.

- You want AI agents to be genuinely useful, by connecting them to real data and real actions safely.

- You have deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC and of large provider APIs like Google Workspace and Microsoft Graph, or you're excited to become the expert.

- You care about reliability: concurrency, retries, rate limits, and observability. You fix root causes, not symptoms.

- You let data decide what to work on. You size user impact from logs and metrics, and you measure error rates before and after every fix.

- You're strong in TypeScript and comfortable shipping across backend services and client UI in a large codebase.

- You enjoy working with customers, partners, QA, and support, and can answer a security review question as clearly as you can fix a bug.

- Bonus: experience with the MCP protocol, Rust, Kubernetes and multi-cloud deployments, enterprise security and compliance (ZDR, audit logs, Conditional Access), or building LLM agents for automation.

SAMPLE PROJECTS INCLUDE

- Building an automated triage system that pulls user reports from feedback channels, groups them by root cause with user-impact estimates, files issues, and starts a first-pass coding agent on each fix

- Redesigning OAuth token refresh so concurrent requests never burn a single-use refresh token and mark a working connector as disconnected

- Cutting hundreds of thousands of daily tool-call errors by generating tool definitions from vendors' published API specs, fixing argument mapping, and adding batch tools

- Shipping Gmail and Outlook draft, reply, and attachment flows, with approval cards so an agent never sends an email without the user's sign-off

- Launching new partner connectors, from debugging a partner's OAuth metadata to rollout and adoption metrics

- Making connectors work for enterprise and single-tenant deployments: custom certificate authorities, Entra Conditional Access, admin controls, and compliance reviews with large financial institutions

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Research Engineer
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Research Engineer to join Encord's ML team. You'll work on robotics, computer vision and multimodal research in data curation, annotation, evaluation and quality control, with successful work going into the core product.

We face a variety of interesting research problems across the full data life-cycle, including annotation, quality control, verification and curation. We are looking to strengthen our team to build upon and extend our market-leading platform. The kind of problems we solve are constantly evolving alongside the needs of our frontier customers, including many of the leading robotics and physical AI teams. Join us as we leverage our massive flow of proprietary data on our journey to develop generalised solutions applicable across diverse multi-modal tasks.

 

What you'll do

- Form hypotheses, design experiments, and drive original research on open problems from leading robotics and AI customers

- Research and prototype agentic workflows which can handle multimodal inputs and diverse customer ontologies

- Advance our work on data curation and model evaluation

- Tackle egocentric video understanding, from captioning to deeper 3d understanding

- Build working prototypes to test ideas end to end, then partner with our ML systems and Product Engineering teammates to bring them into the platform

- Help shape our longer-term research direction and bring the most relevant ideas from the field back to the team

- Publish research papers and present your work at conferences and workshops

 

Who we're looking for

- A builder with a research mindset. You can take an open-ended problem, form a hypothesis and get to a working prototype without a detailed spec.

- A first-principles problem solver. You lean on strong fundamentals rather than surface-level familiarity with the latest trends.

- A big-picture thinker. You're excited by ambitious, longer-term problems and know how to break them into steps.

- A multiplier. You raise the level of the team around you by shaping research direction, mentoring others and turning findings into decisions.

 

Experience requirements

- A PhD in computer vision, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience

- A strong background in computer vision and multimodal ML, whether in traditional CV, modern VLMs and embedding models, or both

- Clear evidence of independent research, such as publications, a thesis, open-source work or applied research where you owned the original contribution

- Solid mathematical foundations in statistics, probability and linear algebra

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, and experience running experiments end-to-end

- A genuine interest in data-centric AI: curation, evaluation and data quality

- Bonus: experience applying LLM-based agents to visual tasks, or working with video, 3D or other complex data types

 

We’ll start reviewing applications from 1 November 2026. It may take a little while to hear back, but every application will get proper consideration.

 

Why Encord

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture - most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Daily company lunches

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

You will take ownership of product development strategy and execution, guiding Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and cell-free DNA-based (cfDNA) In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) products from feasibility through FDA Premarket Approval (PMA) and post-market support. You will establish priorities, allocate resources, and represent development with the FDA and executive leadership, ensuring that scientific rigor and data drive all regulatory and portfolio decisions.

• Communicate portfolio status, risks, and tradeoffs to executive leadership and drive alignment on enterprise priorities

title: Inventory Analyst
tags: Hardware Operations : RMS Supply Chain : Supply Chain
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team at Anduril designs and manufactures solid rocket motors and propulsion systems for the next generation of missiles and munitions. RMS runs a vertically integrated energetics operation - from propellant chemistry and mixing through case fabrication, assembly, and test. We move fast in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment, and we depend on accurate, real-time inventory to keep production lines building.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Inventory Analyst is responsible for managing and optimizing inventory levels to support production schedules while minimizing the costs of scrap, excess and obsolescence. This role will oversee the health of inventory across materials, quality, and production - including energetic and shelf-life-sensitive chemicals unique to a rocket motor environment. The candidate will analyze usage trends, lead cycle counting programs, monitor variances and resolve discrepancies to ensure inventory integrity in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Oversee electronic cycle counts and physical audits to maintain near-perfect record accuracy.

• Investigate root causes of inventory variances and implement corrective actions in our ERP and WMS systems.

• Monitor shelf-life-sensitive materials and ensure compliance with safety and quality storage regulations via the AS9100 Quality Management System.

• Generate KPI reports and visual dashboards to track inventory health, aging stock, and transaction records.

• Collaborate with other manufacturing stakeholders to support operational continuity and efficient forecasting and planning.

• Track shelf-life and expiration on energetic and hazardous materials - ammonium perchlorate (AP), propellant chemicals, and controlled CHM-coded consumables - and flag lots approaching removal, repack, or retest dates before they impact the line.

• Reconcile physical counts to the system of record (Odoo/Oracle), measure count accuracy against the fiscal-year target, and drive root-cause corrections on adjustments.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

•
Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara ’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

•
You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

•
You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

title: Senior Partnership Manager

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Distribution Partnerships team’s mission is taking Airbnb out to the world; working with a range of partners to embed Airbnb in highly trusted and contextually relevant environments to meet guests where they already plan and book their travel, experiences, and services.

The team owns partnerships end to end, from initial ideation, strategy, engagement, and agreement through product launch and ongoing relationship management. Within it, the Business Development (BD) segment owns the front end of the partnership lifecycle: defining strategy, identifying and recruiting partners, structuring commercial agreements, and setting the foundation for long-term partnership success. BD works hand in hand with Partner Management, which grows, measures, and continuously improves each partnership after launch. This role owns partner management for a portfolio of live distribution partners, with approximately 70% of time on day-to-day management and strategic development of existing partners and 30% supporting the team on new partners and renewals, and is growing to become an end to end partnerships leader.

We are looking for an experienced, proactive Senior Partnerships Manager to join our Distribution Partnerships team, reporting to the Director, Distribution Partnerships.  You will manage a portfolio of live distribution partners across our verticals, such as financial services, airlines and loyalty programs, and business travel platforms (the mix may change as priorities shift), and support new partner deals and renewals as you grow into the role.

In the future, you will have an opportunity to contribute to the distribution strategy, help define which segments and partners to target, and support negotiations and deal structuring on individual partnerships. You will carry each deal through launch and into long-term growth, establishing the measurement, forecasting, and feedback loops that let the wider team scale the program globally.

Our partnerships are powered by a portfolio of products that are still being built (embedded booking, points earn and pay with points, embeds, and a partner portal), so you will work closely with Product and Engineering on what partners need and what we can ship. This is a highly cross-functional, high-ambiguity individual-contributor role suited to someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, product, dealmaking, and partner development, and who can build a business from zero to one and one to ten with limited guidance. The role also includes project management and operations, often where processes are not yet defined, so we need someone scrappy and proactive who finds ways to unblock problems we have not identified yet.
